subject: Hearthstone security qualification / DDQ handshake and sprint
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Ellis <timothy.ellis@hearthstonebank.com>
Cc: secops@hearthstonebank.com, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & asks — security qualification (SOC 2 / audit logs / retention / DPA)

Hi Timothy — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

Summary of pain / goals you shared:
- Need to confirm our SOC 2 posture and produce an artifact bundle for procurement (Type II, last 12 months).
- Audit log availability across hosted and dedicated deployment options; retention policy and queryability for 90/180/365-day windows.
- Clarify DPA terms (data residency, deletion windows) and any required retention carve-outs for legal/regs.
- Pen test expectations: scope (external blackbox + authenticated API tests), desired window (Sep 6–10) and proof-of-completion artifact.

What Redwood will deliver / what we asked for from your side:
1) Redwood asks (what we'll send):
   - SOC 2 artifact index + summary (controls map to areas you asked about).
   - Audit-log extraction template and an example query for the 90-day window.
   - Standard DPA + redlines summary and next steps for signature.
   - Recommended pen-test scope doc and sample report format.

2) Hearthstone asks for you (timelines/owners):
   - Upload completed DDQ spreadsheet (we requested the DDQ during the call) to the shared folder so we can map artifacts (Timothy / SecOps).
   - Confirm if you require logs to be preserved for 365 days vs 90; that affects retention sizing and cost profile.

Deliverable timeline (proposed):
- By EOD Thu Aug 6: SOC 2 artifact index + audit-log query (Irene).
- By Fri Aug 7: Redwood sends editable DPA and summary of requested redlines (Legal).
- Week of Aug 9: Align on pen-test window and procurement timeline; we target Sep 6–10 if that works (Timothy to confirm).

Next steps / asks (concrete):
- Timothy: please upload the DDQ to the Google Drive link below and include the procurement contact.
- SecOps: if you have a preferred syslog / SIEM export format, attach an example.
- Jordan / Marissa: internal owners — see internal task list below (I will follow up with a short internal note).

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-hearthstone-ddq
HubSpot deal: https://crm.redwood.com/deals/HS-2026-47

Attachments referenced: Hearthstone_DDQ.xlsx (requested) — please upload there.

Thanks again — I’ll send the SOC2 index and audit-log example by Thursday.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

- We uploaded our completed DDQ (attached) — it is the internal procurement template; you should be able to map items to your artifacts.
- SecOps prefers syslog in JSON/CEF and can provide a 90-day sample export; we will attach sample files separately to the drive.
- Pen test window: Sep 6–10 works for our security calendar. We will confirm procurement timing once DPA redlines are agreed.
- Procurement lead: Angela Park (angela.park@hearthstonebank.com) — looping her on next emails.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Subject: Action items & internal owners — Hearthstone Bank (post-demo)

Jordan / Marissa — adding the items from the call and Timothy's upload. Please treat this as the sprint kickoff for the qualification bundle. I’m copying Hearthstone for transparency but assigning tasks to our internal owners below.

Tasks (owners and recommended ETA):
- Jordan Blake: Prepare SOC 2 artifact package (redwood_soc2-kit.zip) mapped to the DDQ sections. ETA: Thu Aug 6 EOD. Include control IDs and the Type II period.
- Marissa Cole: Generate audit-log extract sample and the audit_log_query.sql we discussed; include a short readme with the retention policy (90 vs 365-day tradeoffs). ETA: Thu Aug 6 EOD.
- Irene Choi: Draft DPA summary + suggested redlines and upload to the Drive by Fri Aug 7.
- Jordan / Marissa: Prep a short summary slide (1 page) on how audit logs are exposed for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments for procurement.

Logistics / where to upload:
- Drive folder (Timothy has access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-hearthstone-ddq
- HubSpot: add follow-up tasks to deal HS-2026-47 and log the DDQ receipt (Irene).

Pen test coordination:
- We will propose the Sep 6–10 window to our red team. Jordan — please prepare the sample reporting template and checklist for scoping before we lock dates.

Notes on sensitive items / evidence handling:
- If any artifacts contain customer PII, route through our secure artifact pipeline and mark as restricted.
- For SOC 2 artifacts that reference internal logs, ensure we provide sanitized exports or redaction notes per the DDQ asks.

Attachments uploaded by us: redwood_soc2-kit.zip, audit_log_query.sql (placeholders attached here for the folder).

I’ll update the HubSpot record after you confirm the artifacts. Let me know if any of the ETAs are unrealistic.

—
